about: Log 403 held-out set (plan item 1), written 2026-10-10 before any run. Every item lists its requirements with a gold verdict: supported (a registered workflow writes it), with_step (a registered workflow's output plus a named step outside NetZoo), needs_input (supported, but the request lacks or rules out an input it needs), not_supported. Families: C supported, N near miss (one necessary condition away from a C item, named in `pair`), U unsupported, P partial (one supported and one unsupported requirement), M missing data, A ambiguous (several registered readings), T multi-turn correction (the last turn decides). Statement/question twins share a `twin` id and must get the same verdicts. Cores do not repeat heldout1-10 or traps.json.
